<div data-module="table" data-set="dice" data-columns="rf"></div>

a) Calculate the relative frequency of each outcome.
b) Estimate $P(X=4)$ and $P(X>3)$.
<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 50 · Example 3.14 · Complete the working in your booklet.</p>

::: notes
Frequencies7,5,6,7,8,17 total50. rf=.14,.10,.12,.14,.16,.34. (b)P(X=4)≈7/50=.14; P(X>3)≈(7+8+17)/50=.64. These are experimental estimates; the theoretical fair-die probabilities would be1/6 and1/2.
:::
